agent.links.needWorkspace: Open the file from your workspace first — the link agent reads neighboring notes.
agent.product.prompt:
Describe the product you want to create:
(e.g. 'A todo app with drag-and-drop, dark mode and local storage')
agent.translate.prompt:
Translate the document into which language?
(e.g. Spanish, עברית, 日本語, Français)
ai.cache.on: On — identical requests are answered locally
ai.cache.title: AI answer cache
ai.trace.title: Agent runs
ai.usage.title: AI usage
autofill.folder: Fill properties for the notes in which folder? (empty = the whole workspace)
autofill.noFields: No property is used in at least two notes yet — add some, then try again
autofill.proposed: {n} proposals are waiting for your approval
batch.apply:
Batch "{op}" finished: {changes} notes to update, {created} new files{failed}.

Apply now? Notes open in a tab are skipped.
batch.confirm:
Send {count} notes to {provider} ({model}) as one batch?

Estimated cost: {cost} (batch price). Results arrive within 24 hours; run "AI: Check Batch Jobs" to apply them. Counts as {count} AI prompts.
batch.confirmLocal: Process {count} notes on this device with {model}? It runs in the background, one note at a time; use "AI: Check Batch Jobs" to apply the results.
batch.noNotes: No notes found in that folder of the workspace
batch.provider: Batch jobs need the OpenAI or Anthropic provider
batch.quota: Not enough AI prompts left this month for {count} notes
batch.saveFailed: Couldn't save the batch job state for {id} (storage full or blocked). Free some space, then run "AI: Check Batch Jobs" again — already-applied results won't be duplicated.
clip.localOnly: Under the local-only policy Lumen does not fetch web pages. Copy the page in your browser and use “Clip from clipboard” instead.
clip.needsService: This page can't be fetched from the browser on this deployment — it needs the research service (VITE_RESEARCH_ENDPOINT). Copy the part you want and use "Clip from clipboard".
fim.on: Local autocomplete on — {model}. Tab accepts, Esc dismisses.
fim.onNoModel: Local autocomplete is on, but no completion model is installed: run "ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:1.5b" (or load an in-browser model).
git.commit.lfsKept: Committed as the repository's Git LFS pointer, not as the file in the vault (LFS is not supported): {files}
git.commit.unresolved: Not committed: resolve the conflicts first: {files}
git.commit.unsaved: Not committed: these open notes have edits that could not be saved first (a change made outside Lumen is being resolved): {files}
git.watch.conflicts: Auto-pull: {count} conflicts marked in the files. Pull to resolve them.
litReview.done: Literature review: {papers} papers, {values} verified values, in “{folder}”.
meeting.empty: There's no transcript in this note
rerank.consent: Turn on the reranking model? It downloads about {mb} MB once (bge-reranker-v2-m3) and runs on this device. On Lumen's Hebrew retrieval test the built-in ranking already puts every answer first.
research.endpoint: Research service URL (run it locally with docker/local-ai.yml — see the docs):
research.noCitations: No footnotes with web links in this note
research.noService: Citation checks and Brave / Tavily search need the research service (VITE_RESEARCH_ENDPOINT) on this deployment
research.provider.claude: Claude web search (Anthropic provider; searches billed by Anthropic)
research.provider.searxng: SearXNG on this machine (no key; local research service)
toast.cite.noCaseNumber: No case number at the cursor: fill in the citation by hand.
toast.gitWatchOnPullingEvery: 👀 Git watch on — pulling every 5 min
toast.productCreatedFilesGenerated: ✅ Product ready: {count} files are waiting for your approval in the review screen
toast.rerankModelOn: Search reranking: local model (downloads on first use)
toast.rerankUnsupported: The search reranking model needs WebGPU or the desktop app; this browser keeps the built-in reranking.
tts.networkVoice.body: This device has no voice for this note. Your browser offers voices that synthesize on the provider's servers, so the note's text would be sent there. The privacy ledger records each use.
tts.networkVoice.title: Use a network voice?
